name: Heroic Spirit Assassin
source:
Series of one-shot fan-fictions of the Nasuverse, their only community is in the protagonist, who does not change. Written in NVL style, it leads you through the meaningful parts of the protagonist's life, while you learn about him step by step.

[From the [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=8182]official website[/url]]
